words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَئِذٍۢ}} ({{tr:yawmaʾidhin}}) does not open a new, free-floating date. It compresses the earlier earthquake sequence into a temporal hinge and makes the reporting clause arrive as the consequence of that marked moment. Because the word is fronted as an accusative time-adverb, the reader receives the event-window before the earth's speech is parsed. The root range leaves room for a decisive interval rather than only a calendar day, while the local compound keeps that range tied to the already introduced scene. After the human question in 99:3, this temporal opener resets the view toward the earth's answer without leaving the earthquake-day. Its repeated use as a Day-scene marker, returning later in the surah at 99:6 and appearing in parallels such as 77:35, 78:18, and 79:8, makes the timing feel formulaic and eschatological, not merely chronological. The internal catch and final nasal tanwīn make the hinge audible: the word turns from general time to pointed then and carries the recitation into disclosure.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperfect reporting: the earth actively makes its stored events known through narration, with feminine agreement carrying the omitted subject
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes occurrence, newness, report, narration, disclosure, and becoming a tale; the local Form II verb selects active causative narration rather than every branch
words.prose: {{ar:تُحَدِّثُ}} ({{tr:tuḥaddithu}}) makes the earth present inside the verb rather than by repeating the noun. Its feminine agreement keeps the earth as the speaking subject, and its imperfect form lets the answer unfold after the completed human question in 99:3. Form II is the main lexical pressure: the earth is not merely a place where events occurred, but the agent that causes those events to become communicable report. The canonical reporting verb is more intimate than a formal announcement reading preserved only as apparatus, so the local payoff is narration from witness-contact. Structurally the verb arrives after the fronted time-frame and takes explicit report-content, binding the act of telling to what is told. Its rare finite use and parallels place it in a Day-speech field (4:42; 4:87), recall a Form II speech duty elsewhere (93:11), and shift report-opening formulas from heard report into earth narration (88:1; 79:15). The breathy opening and doubled middle consonant make that intensive reporting feel compressed and forceful. The verb also creates a forward question that 99:5 answers: the earth can report because it has been addressed by revelation.

words.gloss_range: the earth's own plural reports: possessed, accusative report-content that communicates experience-derived knowledge rather than generic news
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes report, informing, inquiry, tested knowledge, and inner awareness, with unrelated land, cultivation, abundance, softness, and portion branches not locally selected
words.prose: {{ar:أَخْبَارَهَا}} ({{tr:akhbārahā}}) gives the earth's speech concrete content. The possessive suffix makes the reports belong to the earth, and the same referent has already supplied the verb's subject, so the object is best heard as the earth's own disclosures rather than generic news about it. As an accusative object, the word prevents the speech from remaining vague: there are reports being narrated. The broken plural makes those reports multiple and distributed, like entries in an archive. The root pressure adds more than information-transfer; it carries knowledge gained through encounter or testing, so the earth's reports feel like witness-records. Distributional rows about the root's awareness field survive only as background: they mark the plural report noun as a concrete form choice from a field often associated with divine awareness, without importing a divine attribute into the local noun (100:11; 35:31). The Day-knowledge and report-formula parallels keep the reports within a disclosure field while the local suffix keeps the archive earth-owned (100:11; 35:14; 47:31; 9:94). The object also opens out in cadence after the compressed verb, with longer vowel movement and final suffix closure letting the reports expand sonically. Positioned at the ayah's close, the word answers the prior question in 99:3 and points forward to 99:5, where the reason for the earth's speech is given.

topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a plural noun with a possessive suffix, supporting the row family's distributed-report payoff.

topics.reason: V4 supports the root branch of report, inquiry, tested knowledge, and inner knowledge; local grammar keeps that pressure within the plural report-object.

topics.reason: The distributional contrast can mark the selected report noun, but it must not import the divine attribute itself into the local possessed plural; the awareness-field parallels remain background (100:11; 35:31).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus couples the act of recounting at word 2 with plural reports possessed by the feminine speaker at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker turns her own tested inward knowledge into report: speech is the public channel, while direct acquaintance with what lies in her domain gives it evidentiary force.

activation_trace.role: Speech arising as report or conversation supplies the literal recounting and serves as the mechanism's public channel.
Report joined to tested knowledge of an affair's interior makes the possessed content first-hand rather than hearsay.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified feminine subject simply speaks.
changed_reading.after: She recounts reports that belong to her and carry her own inward, experiential knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reporting verb and the possessive 'her reports' jointly anchor an inside-to-outside movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disclosure brings what was unavailable into view, while the reports name knowledge of an interior; the utterance therefore exposes contents from within the speaker's own domain.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure and bringing out supply the outward motion and make speaking an act of exposure.
Tested inward knowledge supplies the concealed content that the disclosure makes available.

changed_reading.before: The line is only an announcement of information.
changed_reading.after: The line stages exposure: concealed contents of the speaker's domain are brought outward as evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The eventive range of the word-2 root remains active inside its explicit speech construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recounting does more than refer backward: speech lets an absent occurrence arise anew as a report, making narration itself a fresh event.

activation_trace.role: Coming into being after nonbeing supplies the eventive renewal by which an absent occurrence becomes present again.
Arising speech or report specifies that the renewed presence occurs through narration rather than physical repetition.
Report grounded in inward knowledge gives the re-presented occurrence determinate evidentiary content.

changed_reading.before: The speaker refers retrospectively to completed events.
changed_reading.after: Her reporting makes absent events newly present as report, so narration is itself a fresh occurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context identifies the feminine speaker as the earth and makes disclosure physical: agitation destabilizes the ground, which carries hidden loads outward before reporting. Altered surface and expelled contents become evidentiary acts, with speech completing an embodied chain of testimony.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure or bringing out anchors the focus report as the final outward phase of the earth's testimony.
Knowledge of an affair's interior makes the earth competent to testify about what its own interior held.
Agitation and shaking supply the literal destabilization that initiates the inside-to-outside sequence.
The lower ground opposed to the sky identifies the speaker and locates the testimony in a material below.
Taking something out of concealment supplies the earth's physical disclosure of previously hidden contents.
A burdening load supplies the substantial contents carried and then expelled by the witness.

structural_cues: The recurring feminine possessive and indirect-object suffix links the shaking, burdens, reports, and recipient across 99:1-5.
The explicit earth in 99:1-2 and the extraction in 99:2 immediately prepare the feminine report in 99:4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaken earth, removal of hidden burdens, and focus disclosure; I infer a causal chain from agitation to extrusion to testimony. A live alternative is that the physical events merely precede a wholly verbal report.

changed_reading.before: A feminine speaker discloses inward knowledge verbally.
changed_reading.after: The earth testifies with its body as well as speech: shaking and extrusion expose its interior, and the utterance names that material evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human's perceptual and conjectural utterance is followed by the earth's inwardly grounded report. Surface bewilderment therefore yields to substrate knowledge, creating an unequal exchange between observer and witness.

activation_trace.role: Speech arising as report supplies the earth's answering mode.
Tested inward knowledge gives the answer a depth unavailable to an observer limited to appearances.
A saying that runs as supposition sharpens the human utterance as uncertain conjecture rather than informed testimony.
Perceiving by sight, sensation, or hearing supplies the human's surface-bound access to the event.

structural_cues: The human question in 99:3 immediately precedes the earth's report in 99:4.
The feminine pronoun in the question points to the same referent whose reports are possessed in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human speech framed by perception, then the earth's report grounded in inward knowledge; I infer a question-answer correction from adjacency. The live alternative is rhetorical juxtaposition without a direct reply relation.

changed_reading.before: The earth's report is an isolated monologue.
changed_reading.after: Its report answers and corrects human surface conjecture with the witness's first-hand knowledge of its own interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereign address and hidden impartation are converted into public report. The earth is not merely a spontaneous witness; its disclosure is commissioned and activated by communication from its Lord.

activation_trace.role: Publicly arising speech or report is the outward form taken by the prior hidden address.
Inwardly grounded report supplies the authoritative content expressed under commission.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the authority under which the witness speaks.
The hidden imparting of knowledge supplies the private communication that the earth converts into public testimony.

structural_cues: The causal opening of 99:5 grammatically grounds the reporting of 99:4.
The feminine recipient in 99:5 corefers with the feminine speaker in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereign lordship, hidden impartation, and an explicit causal link; I infer that the communication authorizes and activates the report. It may supply content, but the live alternative is a command or permission rather than informational dictation.

changed_reading.before: The earth reports because it independently possesses a memory.
changed_reading.after: The earth gives commissioned testimony: concealed address under sovereign authority becomes public, evidentiary speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report changes modality from something recounted to something shown. Its content is linked to intentional deeds, so testimony becomes inspectable evidence rather than an auditory narrative alone.

activation_trace.role: Arising speech or report supplies the initial communicative modality that the later display transforms.
Tested knowledge of inner reality supplies evidentiary content capable of being made inspectable.
Causing to see and making manifest converts reported knowledge into a public display.
Intentional action identifies deeds as the concrete content exposed by the report-display.

structural_cues: The purpose clause in 99:6 follows reporting with the showing of people's deeds.
The seeing verb recurs in both 99:7 and 99:8, extending display across both evaluative outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, showing, and intentional deeds; I infer that the reports feed or constitute the display of deeds. The live alternative is that reporting and showing are successive but independent evidentiary stages.

changed_reading.before: The earth's testimony is heard as narrated information.
changed_reading.after: The testimony becomes demonstrative: the deeds known and reported by the earth are made perceptible to their agents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence converts aggregate hidden burdens into dispersed, deed-specific, minutely weighed items and preserves both beneficial and harmful valences. The plural reports function as an exhaustive ledger that decomposes stored history into accountable units.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure and bringing out anchor the focus as the conversion point where stored material becomes an exposed account.
Plural reports grounded in inner knowledge supply the ledger's comprehensive informational contents.
A carried burden supplies the aggregate store from which the later account is decomposed.
Dispersion and separation supply individualized distribution rather than one undifferentiated public mass.
Intentional deeds supply the ledger's accountable item type.
Weight and measure convert the earlier burden into calibrated units.
Minute, dispersed particles set the account's lower scale and block loss through coarse aggregation.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies one preserved evaluative class.
Evil and harm supply the opposed class, making the account bidirectional rather than selectively favorable.

structural_cues: The recurrence from the earth's burdens in 99:2 to a particle's weight in the parallel clauses of 99:7-8 creates a large-load-to-small-measure arc around the focus.
Plural reports precede separated people and two nearly mirrored clauses that differ chiefly in good versus evil.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aggregate burden, dispersion, deeds, minute measure, and matched good/evil outcomes; I infer that the intervening reports perform the conversion into an exhaustive ledger. The live alternative is that these are separate stages without an itemization function assigned to 99:4.

changed_reading.before: The earth gives a global narrative about what happened.
changed_reading.after: The earth exposes an exhaustive account that resolves stored history into individualized, particle-scale deed entries across both good and evil.

changed_reading.after: As a contained economic analogy, the earth's disclosure functions like account settlement: deeds are weighed, matched with return, and apportioned rather than merely narrated.

strongest_changes: Context identifies the speaker as the earth and recasts reporting as embodied extraction of hidden evidence.
The causal hidden address of 99:5 turns an apparently autonomous witness into commissioned testimony.
Later showing, separation, weighing, particle-scale measure, and good/evil symmetry turn the reports into a visible granular audit.
summary.what_was_special: The focus branch pair joined renewed speech and disclosure to tested inward knowledge; context then activated the earth as substrate, answerer, commissioned witness, and itemizing interface. Land-yield and portion-exchange branches preserve two contained material analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The hidden communication in 99:5 may supply content, command, or permission.
The shown deeds in 99:6-8 may be constituted by the earth's reports or may follow them as an independent evidentiary stage.
The land-yield and settlement models depend on form-distant branch echoes and should remain analogical.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Earth’s report as newly arising speech.** Lexical evidence: `ح د ث B003` speech that arises as report/conversation; `خ ب ر B001` report and tested inner knowledge. Structural cue: the ayah answers the human’s `ما لها` by giving earth a reporting verb and an object of reports. Assigned role: `تحدث` is the act of converting inner knowledge into fresh report; `أخبارها` is the tested content. Abductive move: I infer that the earth reports from experience of what occurred upon/in it because `خ ب ر` includes inward tested knowledge, not mere transmitted rumor. Reading change: earth becomes a witness with experiential knowledge, not a passive stage.

2. **Disclosure after emergence.** Lexical evidence: `ح د ث B006` disclosure/bringing out; `خ ر ج B002` causing hidden matter to come out in 99:2. Structural cue: physical خروج precedes verbal تحديث. Assigned role: the ayah turns extracted matter into legible statement. Abductive move: I supply the two-step evidentiary process: first expose the contents, then disclose their meaning. Reading change: the ayah is not just “the earth tells news”; it is the interpretive phase after material evidence has been produced.

3. **The calamity becomes narrated event.** Lexical evidence: `ح د ث B005` event/calamity of time; `ز ل ز ل B002` time’s shocks; `ق و ل B007` public circulating talk. Structural cue: `يومئذ` ties earth’s reporting to the decisive day opened by `إذا`. Assigned role: the quake is both event and the origin of reports about events. Abductive move: I infer that the earth’s reports include the history of events accumulated in time, because the packet links day, shocks, deeds, and seeing. Reading change: `أخبارها` expands from the earth’s present condition to the record of what time deposited in it.

4. **Soft-earth knowledge reading.** Lexical evidence: `خ ب ر B002` soft low ground and water-gathering place; `خ ب ر B003` working soft land through sharecropping; activated by `ء ر ض B002` fertile soft ground and `خ ر ج B003` yield from land. Structural cue: earth in 99:2 outputs burdens; earth in 99:4 reports. Assigned role: the earth is not only hard witness but worked ground whose inward softness retains traces and yields reports. Abductive move: I infer that cultivation/yield imagery can underwrite moral accounting: worked land gives back what was placed into it. Reading change: `أخبارها` reads as harvest-like output of a worked earth, not merely oral narration.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 99:5 made the earth’s speech less autonomous and more commissioned: `تحدث` depends on `أوحى لها`. 99:7-8 also changed `أخبارها` from “news about the earth” toward “news about actions”: the reports are activated by the later visible `أعمال`, so the earth’s خبر becomes a moral archive.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The event is converted into its own narration.** Fixed `ح د ث/B001` supplies an event coming into being, `B005` a calamity of time, and `B003` speech arising as report. The temporal `يَوْمَئِذٍ` points back to the quake and extraction, while the form `تُحَدِّثُ` turns that occurrence-root into an act of telling. The root's assigned role is to join happening and narration: what occurs becomes what is recounted. The claim that the material event itself encodes the report is inferred. Earth therefore does not merely comment on a calamity external to its speech; its event becomes its testimony.

2. **The earth discloses tested interior knowledge.** Fixed `ح د ث/B006` supplies disclosure or bringing out, and fixed `خ ب ر/B001` supplies both report and tested knowledge of an affair's interior rather than its outward appearance. This follows concealment being made to emerge (`خ ر ج/B002`) and precedes deeds being made visible (`ر ء ي/B012`). The two fixed words serve as the epistemic middle stage between extraction and display. The inference is that the earth has retained an interior record that its report now externalizes. `أَخْبَارَهَا` accordingly reads as evidentiary knowledge from within the earth, not generic news.

3. **The report can function as an agricultural ledger.** Fixed `خ ب ر/B002` supplies soft, low, water-gathering ground, and `B003` supplies cultivation for a known share of what the earth produces. Repeated `ٱلْأَرْضُ` activates the ground image; 99:6-8 then name intentional deeds (`ع م ل/B001`) and exact weight (`ث ق ل/B004`). The fixed `أَخْبَارَهَا` takes the role of a yield-account: the earth tells what each person's work produced. The move from human acts to planted or cultivated inputs is inferred, so this is exploratory. It makes the news a reckoning of produce rather than a detached verbal chronicle.

4. **A private interior becomes a public and individualized tale.** Fixed `ح د ث/B004` supplies becoming a tale people tell. The earth speaks in the singular here, after human `ق و ل/B001`, but 99:6 disperses the people and 99:7-8 end with each person seeing the relevant act. The assigned role of `تُحَدِّثُ` is dissemination: one earth-record reaches separated recipients. The transmission from singular testimony to every individual is an inferred arrow. The report thus reads as the conversion of hidden local history into a universally distributed public record.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 99:5 immediately corrected any reading of autonomous earth-speech by supplying its cause and authorization in `أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا`. Ayat 99:6-8 then revealed the report's practical output: deeds are displayed to dispersed people and resolved into singular, minute instances. That later movement activated fixed `ح د ث/B004` as a tale distributed to people and sharpened `خ ب ر/B001` from general news into evidence that culminates in sight.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilgi ve iç yüz eksenli çerçevesi kaynak ifadesini genel olarak karşılar; ancak anlam yalnızca edinilmiş bilgi değildir. Bilgiyi başkasına iletme, soru sorarak bilgi edinme, sınama ve deneyim yoluyla bir işin iç yüzünü tanıma ile dış görünüşten ayrılan gerçek nitelik de dalın sınırları içinde tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın biçimlere dayanır; tanım herhangi bir kalıba bağlanmadan bilgi edinme, bildirme, sınama ve iç niteliği bilme alanını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şey hakkında bilgi edinme veya edinilen bilgiyi başkasına iletme; ayrıca sorarak öğrenme, sınama ve deneyim yoluyla bir işin iç yüzünü tanıma alanıdır. Bir kimsenin ya da şeyin dış görünüşünden ayrılan gerçek niteliği de bu bilgi alanının uzantısı olarak belirtir.

facets.statement: Bir şey veya olay hakkında edinilen ve aktarılabilen bilgiyi belirtir.
Edinilen bilgiyi bir başkasına bildirme ve onun bilgilenmesini sağlama eylemini kapsar.
Soru sorarak bilgi aramayı ve bir şeyi sınayıp deneyerek tanımayı kapsar.
Bir işin iç yüzünü bilen kişiyi ve dış görünüşün karşısındaki gerçek iç niteliği belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kaynak tanıklığında aynı yalın biçim, yumuşak bitkiyi, yün veya ince hayvan kılını ve devenin ağzından çıkan köpüğü ayrı ayrı adlandırır. Bu referentler için kaynakça desteklenen tek bir ortak kavramsal çekirdek kurulamaz.

facets.statement: Kesilip yenebilen yumuşak bitkiyi belirtir.
Yünü veya ince ve yumuşak hayvan kılını belirtir.
Devenin ağzında oluşan ya da ağzından attığı köpüğü belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.text: yumuşak bitki, yün veya ince kıl ve deve ağzı köpüğü
concept_gloss.applicability: Kanıttaki sınırlı adlandırma kümesinin üç referentini birlikte göstermek gerektiğinde uygundur; tek üretken çekirdek iddiası taşımaz.

error_profile.preserves: Yumuşak bitkiyi, yün veya ince hayvan kılını ve deve ağzı köpüğünü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözcüğün yumuşak ve yenebilir bitkiyi adlandırdığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yumuşak bitki referentini ve yenebilme bağlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yün veya ince kıl ile deve ağzı köpüğü referentlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözcüğün hayvan üzerindeki yün ya da ince kılı adlandırdığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yün veya ince hayvan kılı referentini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yumuşak bitki ile deve ağzı köpüğü referentlerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözcüğün devenin ağzında oluşan veya ağzından atılan köpüğü adlandırdığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Deve ağzındaki köpük referentini açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Yumuşak bitki ile yün veya ince hayvan kılı referentlerini kapsamaz.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخبير للنبات اللين والوبر وزبد أفواه الإبل أو ما يلقيه البعير من فيه
branches.source_phrase_ar: الخبير النبات اللين (maqayis)؛ الخبير النبات (sihah)؛ الخبير الوبر (maqayis;sihah)؛ الخبير زبد أفواه الإبل (sihah)؛ الخبير الزبد الذي يلقيه البعير من فيه (jamhara)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir topluluğun ortaklaşa satın alıp kestiği ve etini bölüştüğü koyunu temel olaylı referent olarak verir; etten veya balıktan alınan pay bunun bölüşüm sonucunu genelleştiren bağlantılı anlamıdır. Sağlanan çerçeve süreç, nesne ve sonuç ayrımını korumaya elverişlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın biçimlere dayanır; tanım ortaklaşa alınan koyun ile bölüşümden doğan et veya balık payını aşamalı olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun ortaklaşa satın aldığı, kestiği ve etini aralarında paylaştığı koyunu belirtir. Bununla bağlantılı olarak, bölüşümde bir kişinin etten veya balıktan aldığı payı da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun ortaklaşa satın alıp kestiği ve etini kendi arasında bölüştüğü koyunu belirtir.
Bir bölüşüm sonucunda kişiye düşen et veya balık payını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik tanıklık ortaklaşa koyun satın alma, kesme ve eti bölüşme sürecini verir; etten veya balıktan alınan pay da bu bölüşüm çekirdeğinin sonuçsal uzantısıdır.

concept_gloss.text: ortak alınıp kesilen koyun veya bölüşülen et-balık payı
concept_gloss.applicability: Ortak alım, kesim ve bölüşüme konu olan koyunla bundan doğan yiyecek payının birlikte gösterildiği dal düzeyi açıklamada uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ortaklaşa alınan koyunu, kesim ve bölüşüm aşamalarını ve sonuçtaki et veya balık payını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun koyunu birlikte satın alıp kesmesi ve etini kendi arasında paylaşması bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ortak alım, kesim ve etin katılımcılar arasında bölüşülmesi sürecini korur.
error_profile.loses: Etten veya balıktan alınan genel pay uzantısını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir bölüşüm sonunda kişiye düşen et ya da balık bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bölüşüm sonucunda alınan yiyecek payını korur.
error_profile.loses: Koyunun ortaklaşa satın alınması, kesilmesi ve bütün etinin paylaşılması olayını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ortaklaşa alınıp kesilen ve eti bölüşülen koyun

error_profile.preserves: Bir bölüşümde kişiye düşen pay yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Mülkiyet, şirket ortaklığı veya soyut hak payı gibi çok daha geniş kullanım alanları ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ortak kesim olayını ve payın et ya da balık olması koşulunu belirsizleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ortak alınan koyun, kesim ve payın özellikle etten veya balıktan alınması koşulları bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyden bir kişiye ayrılmış belirli hakkı veya bölümü genel olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bölüşülen bir şeyden belirli bir kişiye düşen bölümü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yiyecek payını ortak koyun kesimiyle bağlantılı olarak sınırlar; komşu dal nesne türünden ve kesim sürecinden bağımsız genel pay kavramıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ortak satın alınan koyunun tamamını ve et ya da balık payını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bölüşümde ilk ayrılan payı ve özellikle büyük bir deve eti parçasını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kesilmiş hayvan etinin bölüşümünde bir kişiye ayrılan payı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda payın ilk olması veya büyük bir parça olması gerekmez ve balığı da kapsar; komşu dal ilk ayrılma ve deve eti özellikleriyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ortak koyun kesimi ile et veya balık olarak alınan payı belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyin tam üçte birini veya üçte ikisini oran olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir bütünün bölünmesi ve bir bölümün ayrılması alanında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yiyecek türü ve ortak kesim süreciyle, komşu dal ise payın kesin oranıyla tanımlanır; biri diğerinin yerine geçmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخُبْرة للشاة المشتركة التي يذبحها القوم ويقتسمون لحمها أو للنصيب من اللحم والسمك

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, bilgi edinme ve iletmeden gevşek-sulu araziye, ürün paylı tarımsal ortakçılığa, büyük su tulumu ile bol verimli deve benzetmesine, birbiriyle yapısal olarak ayrılması gereken bitki-yün-köpük adlarına ve ortak kesim payına uzanan altı belirgin dal taşır. Dallar tek bir eş zamanlı çekirdekten çok bağımsız anlamlar ve sınırlı benzetme ya da sonuç ilişkileri halinde düzenlenir.

concept_gloss.text: bilgi edinme, bildirme ve deneyimle içyüzü kavrama

error.reason: Bu gloss haber ve aktarılan bilgiyi verir, sorarak veya deneyerek öğrenme ile iç nitelik anlamlarını kapsamaz.
Bu gloss bildirme eylemini verir, sınayıp tanıma ve içyüz bilgisi alanını dışarıda bırakır.
Bu gloss soru yoluyla bilgi aramayı verir, bilginin kendisini, bildirmeyi ve iç niteliği kapsamaz.
Bu gloss deneyim ve içyüz bilgisini verir, genel bilgi ve başkasına bildirme yönlerini ayrıca taşımaz.
Bu gloss deneyimli bilen kişiye odaklanır, bilgi nesnesi ve bildirme eylemi anlamlarını vermez.
Bu gloss içyüzü bilen kişiyi verir, bilgi aktarma ve soruşturup sınama süreçlerini kapsamaz.

lu_007.text: kişinin dış görünüşe karşı iç niteliği

error.reason: Bu gloss iç nitelik anlamını verir, bilgi edinme, bildirme ve deneyerek öğrenme alanlarını içermez.

error.reason: Ana etiket arazi niteliğini verir, akışın oluşturduğu geçilebilir su birikintisini ayrıca belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.text: yumuşak, alçak ve su toplayan toprak

error.reason: Bu gloss arazi niteliğini verir, akış yatağındaki geçilebilir su birikintisini ayrıca adlandırmaz.

error.reason: Bu gloss sulu ve ağaçlı yer niteliğine odaklanır, gevşek alçak araziyi ve su birikintisini kapsamaz.
Bu gloss su birikintisini verir, gevşek arazi ve sıcak ağaçlı yer anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

concept_gloss.text: ürün payına dayalı çiftçilik ortakçılığı

contextual_glosses.text: mahsulden belirli pay karşılığı ortak ekim

error.reason: Bu gloss çiftçi rolünü verir, ürün payına dayalı ortakçılık düzenini kapsamaz.
Bu gloss ortakçılık düzenini verir, toprağı işleyen kişi adını ayrıca karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.text: yün veya ince yumuşak hayvan kılı

error.reason: Bu gloss bitkiyi verir, yumuşak hayvan kılı ve deve ağzı köpüğü varyantlarını kapsamaz.

lu_016.text: yün veya ince yumuşak hayvan kılı

error.reason: Bu gloss hayvan kılı anlamını verir, yenebilir bitki ve deve ağzı köpüğü anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.
Bu gloss köpük anlamını verir, yumuşak bitki ve hayvan kılı varyantlarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.text: bölüşümden düşen et veya balık payı

Bu gloss pay anlamını verir, ortaklaşa alınıp kesilen koyunu adlandırmaz.
